 10 Best IPO Platforms in India for 2026
 Shree 
 Shree 
 Author 
 Follow 
 View profile 
 Last updated: 11 November 2026 
 Save 
 Share 
 Join Us 
 Follow Us 
 Add as Source 
 An Initial Public Offering (IPO) is an exciting opportunity for retail investors to invest in a company's early growth stage. Seamless bidding for mainboard and SME issues, however, necessitates a dependable platform with expedient UPI mandate execution, pre-bidding features, and real-time information on every Upcoming IPO .
 Here is an in-depth look at the 10 best IPO platforms in India for 2026, including the market leader, Kotak Neo, along with some of the best and emerging brokers.
 1. Kotak Neo
 Kotak Neo is one of India's leading investment platforms, designed to offer an instant, hassle-free application process for upcoming IPOs. Powered by Kotak Securities, Kotak Neo combines institutional-grade security with an intuitive, modern interface.
 Key Highlights
 ● Instant UPI Applications: Complete IPO bids in seconds with automated mandate generation and tracking; Instant UPI Applications.
 ● Place Bids Before IPO: Don't wait until the last minutes of the IPO window, as the bidding rush will occur.
 ● Comprehensive Analytics: Financial Breakdowns, Red Herring Prospectuses (RHP), and subscription status can be found within the App.
 ● Zero-Brokerage Plans: Benefit from very competitive pricing structures in delivery, intraday, and primary market business.
 2. Zerodha (Kite)
 Zerodha provides a simple and straightforward IPO bidding module on its Kite platform and is one of the top discount brokers in India.
 Key Highlights 
 ● Simple Interface: Simplified application process using UPI.
 ● Family Account Management: Apply for IPOs across multiple family accounts without hassle.
 ● Console Analytics: Built-in analytics dashboard to track application and allotment history.
 3. Angel One
 Angel One is a full-service digital broker that offers end-to-end IPO application capabilities, with data-driven insights.
 Key Highlights 
 ● One-Click Bidding: Retail investors can process UPI mandates in just a single click.
 ● Smart Analytics: Built-in tools and suggestions about company basics.
 ● Mainboard & SME Coverage: 100% coverage across Mainboard and SME exchanges.
 4. Groww
 Groww is widely used by new investors because its platform offers an easy-to-navigate interface, and the process of becoming a new investor is paperless.
 Key Highlights 
 ● Easy-to-Use Interface: Smooth and convenient for first-timers in the primary market.
 ● Live Status Tracking: Live updates of mandate approvals and allotment confirmation.
 ● In-App Insights: Built-in guides to help users check issue metrics before applying.
 5. Upstox
 Upstox provides a strong platform best suited to active investors who want to place trades in the competitive bidding window.
 Key Highlights
 ● Pre-Apply Feature: Bid before the IPO Opening Date.
 ● Smart Order Routing: Ensures the back end works reliably even during high market volume.
 ● Easy to see: Key issue highlights, lot sizes, and price bands in one view.
 6. ICICI Direct
 ICICI Direct is a pioneer full-service broker offering multi-bank ASBA and UPI payment integration.
 Key Highlights 
 ● 3-in-1 Account: Direct linkage of bank, demat, and trading account.
 ● ASBA & UPI Flexibility: Option to block funds via net banking ASBA or UPI.
 ● Institutional Research: In-depth research reports and IPO ratings.
 7. Dhan
 Dhan is a technology-driven broker emerging as a top option for modern retail investors and active traders.
 Key Highlights 
 ● Fast Execution: An optimized engine for instant UPI mandate approval requests.
 ● Allotment Tracking: Track allotment notifications and refund status in-app.
 ● Smooth design: Smooth transitions between the main market application and secondary trading.
 8. HDFC Securities
 HDFC Securities provides a safe trading platform with a vast private banking network.
 Key Highlights 
 ● 3-In-1 Integration: Direct integration with HDFC Bank account for quick blocking of funds.
 ● Comprehensive Research : Extensive study of issuer fundamentals, valuation, and risks.
 ● High Security: Solid foundation for both high net-worth and retail investors.
 9. 5paisa
 5paisa is a discount brokerage firm that provides investment services with low investment rates in the equity, mutual funds, and IPO categories.
 Key Highlights 
 ● Flat Fees: Low fees for all investment levels.
 ● Fast UPI payment links: Invest in mainboard and SME IPOs in a quick manner.
 ● Unified Dashboard: All portfolio holdings and primary market bids in one place.
 10. Paytm Money
 Paytm Money has created a convenient mobile-first platform for retail investors who prefer to invest through the retail market.
 Key Highlights
 ● Seamless Payments: Direct integration with Paytm UPI for quick approval of mandates.
 ● Pre-Open Bidding: Users can make bids prior to market opening.
 ● Time-Sensitive Alerts: Alerts for upcoming issues, bidding deadlines, and allotment releases via push notifications.

 Conclusion
 Several factors matter when choosing the right platform, whether you want seamless bank integration, extensive research, or fast execution.
 Some platforms lead the way, such as Kotak Neo, which offers pre-bidding options, a high mandate success rate, and strong analytical tools, while others are reliable alternatives. Before your next IPO application, check usability, application speed, and access to research.
